scope: Independent source inspection; six N source files and design against original UE56 and installed UE58 source. No engine/build execution, no source edits.

findings.problem: FEnumProperty enum/underlying metadata is dereferenced without a guard. Installed UE58 explicitly permits a null Enum after its class is moved/deleted. A scalar query or enum array element can crash, and an empty enum array bypasses element checks before FArrayProperty::GetCPPType calls inner GetCPPType, which checks Enum.
findings.requested_change: Reject missing enum/underlying metadata before scalar read and before any enum-array export, including empty arrays; return explicit error before GetCPPType. Do not synthesize successful readback.
findings.evidence: EnumProperty.cpp 411-425 documents moved/deleted enum; GetCPPType 387-388 checks metadata; PropertyArray.cpp 987-996 calls inner GetCPPType; original serializer guards enum name lookup.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed path, not runtime reproduced. Add disposable/synthetic missing-enum and empty enum-array tests.

findings.problem: Template validity and finite transform checks occur only after component-name filtering. Tree ownership/cycle/name checks cover all reachable nodes, while unmatched template/transform checks are skipped. The design prose currently describes invalid templates/nonfinite transforms as globally rejected.
findings.requested_change: Either state that selected component rows alone receive template/transform checks, or validate the relevant invariants before filtering. This does not invalidate the claimed local reachable enumeration scope.

findings.problem: Scalar FString/FText/name values are copied into JSON before max_value_chars is tested. Output size is bounded, but the limit is not a strict temporary allocation bound.
findings.requested_change: Prefer an FString length precheck before JSON allocation; otherwise explicitly retain the distinction between return-size limit and total temporary memory guarantee. FText/reference resolution can also perform implicit work.

positive_conclusions: Direct root/child access avoids GetAllNodes legacy cache writes and SubobjectData inherited override creation.
Selectors are bounded below NAME_SIZE; property lookup compares text rather than making new FNames.
Load/PostLoad scope is disclosed, failed load is unknown change state, successful already-loaded reads alone are retry-safe within reported dirty/status scope.
ON_SCOPE_EXIT captures dirty/status even on early failures; actual observed changes fail the operation.
Only plain scalar arrays use generic text export after bounded inspection; unsupported arbitrary native exporters remain explicit failures.
Hidden reflected library has AIIgnore and belongs to existing editor module; this source slice introduces no gameplay/runtime module.
Local-only, no inherited/native-CDO/orphan guarantee, sorted ordering and unsupported types are explicitly incomplete legacy equivalence.
